name: Emsdetten (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of white with narrow green and white stripes along both edges, charged at the top with the city arms of Emsdetten (a white bend on green).
history: Municipal flag of Emsdetten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Emsdetten arms — white bend on green
